user.title: Proportional Light Setup
user.description: Select the lights you want to group together. Each light will maintain its individual brightness relationship while being controlled as one group.

data_description.proportion_reset_mode: Never: keep proportions always | On turn off: reset when turned off | On specific brightness: reset when turned on with explicit brightness (e.g., Ambient Light) | On both: combination
data_description.proportion_reset_timeout: Auto-reset after this time when lights are off (0 = disabled)
